quote: Израиль сыграл большую роль в создании тайной полиции шаха «САВАК».
translation: Israel played a large role in creating the Shah's secret police, SAVAK.

quote: Мохаммед Реза был первым из мусульманских лидеров, установившим дипломатические отношения с Израилем, что использовало радикальное мусульманское духовенство для критики шаха как «пособника политики сионистов».
translation: Mohammad Reza was the first Muslim leader to establish diplomatic relations with Israel, which radical Muslim clergy used to criticize the Shah as an "accomplice of Zionist policy."

quote: On 24 July 1959, Mohammad Reza gave Israel implicit recognition by allowing an Israeli trade office to be opened in Tehran that functioned as a de facto embassy, a move that offended many in the Islamic world.
section: Self-assertion: from figurehead monarch to effective authoritarian

quote: L'Iran est le deuxième État à majorité musulmane, après la Turquie, à reconnaître l'État d’Israël, considéré comme son meilleur ami non-musulman, le 14 mars 1950.
section: Le jeune shah et son royaume à la fin des années 1940
translation: Iran was the second Muslim-majority state, after Turkey, to recognize the State of Israel, regarded as its best non-Muslim friend, on 14 March 1950.

quote: بعدها گفته شد که وی عضو یک گروه کمونیستی-اسلامی بوده است. شاه به شکلی غیررسمی انگشت اتهام را به سوی انگلستان نیز نشانه گرفت.
translation: It was later said that he was a member of a communist-Islamic group. The Shah also unofficially pointed the finger of blame at Britain.

quote: Tout au plus, l'enquête révèle que l'auteur de l'attentat s'appelait Nasser Fakhr-Araï, qu'une carte de presse lui avait permis de déjouer la surveillance et qu'il est membre du Tudeh. Les investigations policières révèlent en outre des complicités dans les rangs islamistes.
translation: At most, the investigation shows that the attacker was named Nasser Fakhr-Arai, that a press card had let him evade surveillance, and that he was a member of the Tudeh. Police investigations also revealed complicity in Islamist ranks.

quote: ليتبين من التحقيقات أنه كان أحد أعضاء حزب توده الشيوعي المحظور والموالي للاتحاد السوفياتي.
translation: Investigations then showed that he was a member of the banned communist Tudeh Party, which was loyal to the Soviet Union.

quote: After an investigation, Fakhr-Arai was declared a member of the communist Tudeh Party, which was subsequently banned. However, there is evidence that the would-be assassin was not a Tudeh member but a religious fundamentalist member of Fada'iyan-e Islam.

Mit den Worten „Ich bin müde und brauche eine Pause“ verließ der Schah Mohammad Reza Pahlavi, begleitet von seiner Familie, am Mittag des 16. Januars 1979 über den Teheraner Flughafen das Land für immer.
translation: With the words "I am tired and need a break," Shah Mohammad Reza Pahlavi, accompanied by his family, left the country for good at noon on 16 January 1979 via Tehran airport.

quote: Le nouveau Premier ministre Bakhtiar, pour pouvoir rétablir la situation, demande au chah de quitter l'Iran pour une durée indéterminée. En réalité, fatigué et malade, le chah lui-même voulait absolument quitter le pays, alors que depuis plusieurs mois, la rumeur de son départ s'était répandue.
translation: The new prime minister, Bakhtiar, in order to restore the situation, asked the Shah to leave Iran for an indefinite period. In reality, tired and ill, the Shah himself absolutely wanted to leave the country, while for several months the rumor of his departure had been spreading.

quote: On 16 January 1979, Mohammad Reza Shah made a contract with Farboud and left Iran at the behest of Prime Minister Shapour Bakhtiar (a longtime opposition leader himself), who sought to calm the situation. The Shah publicly announced that he was leaving Iran for a "vacation".

في 16 يناير 1979، قرر الشاه مغادرة إيران للمرة الثانية ورفض حفظ ملكه حقنًا للدماء واحتراما لإرادة الشعب الإيراني، إثر اضطرابات شعبية هائلة ومظاهرات عارمة نظمتهما منظمات يسارية ورجال الدين الشيعة في العاصمة طهران مستغلين سياسة الحكومة الجديدة في حرية التعبير ضد الحكومة والسماح بحرية التعبير السياسي بلا قيود.
translation: On 16 January 1979, the Shah decided to leave Iran for the second time and refused to preserve his throne in order to avoid bloodshed and out of respect for the will of the Iranian people, after huge popular unrest and massive demonstrations organized by leftist organizations and Shia clerics in Tehran.

quote: محمدرضاشاه در نهایت در ۲۶ دی ۱۳۵۷، در پی اعتراض‌های گسترش‌یافتهٔ مخالفان به رهبری روح‌الله خمینی ایران را ترک کرد. او گفته بود که ترجیح می‌دهد کشور را ترک کند تا اینکه مردم خود را بکشد.
translation: Mohammad Reza Shah finally left Iran on 26 Dey 1357, following the spread of opposition protests led by Ruhollah Khomeini. He had said that he preferred to leave the country rather than kill his own people.

quote: Les groupes d'opposition véhiculèrent cependant l’idée d’un massacre de « 15 000 morts et blessés » ce qui déclencha encore plus de manifestations dans tout le pays contre le gouvernement et conduisit à des grèves générales, qui affectèrent également l'industrie pétrolière.
translation: Opposition groups nevertheless spread the idea of a massacre of "15,000 dead and wounded," which set off still more demonstrations across the country against the government and led to general strikes, which also affected the oil industry.

quote: في نهاية عام 1973 وبينما كان الشاه في جزيرة كيش٬ لاحظ وجود تجويف في أدنى الجزء الايسر من القفص الصدري واعتقد أنه تضخم في الطحال٬ ولدى فحصه بعد ذلك تبين وجود تضخم في الطحال، ولكن ليس هناك تضخم في الغدد.
translation: At the end of 1973, while the Shah was on Kish Island, he noticed a hollow at the lower left of his ribcage and thought it was an enlarged spleen; examination then found an enlarged spleen, but no enlarged glands.

quote: On the first visit, Flandrin was able to diagnose the Shah with chronic lymphocytic leukemia. The Shah's diagnosis of cancer would not be revealed to him until 1978.
1967 krönte er sich vom Schah („König“) zum Schahanschah („Kaiser“) und führte außerdem die Ehrentitel Aryamehr („Licht der Arier“) und Bozorg Arteschtaran („Oberbefehlshaber“).
translation: In 1967 he crowned himself from Shah ("king") to Shahanshah ("emperor") and also used the honorary titles Aryamehr ("Light of the Aryans") and Bozorg Arteshtaran ("commander-in-chief").

quote: محمدرضا پس از به پادشاهی رسیدن پدرش، در هفت سالگی به ولیعهدی رسید.
translation: After his father became king, Mohammad Reza became crown prince at the age of seven.

quote: محمدرضاشاه پهلوی (۴ آبان ۱۲۹۸ – ۵ مرداد ۱۳۵۹) دومین و آخرین شاه ایران از دودمان پهلوی بود که از ۲۵ شهریور ۱۳۲۰ تا ۲۲ بهمن ۱۳۵۷ حکومت کرد.
translation: Mohammad Reza Shah Pahlavi (4 Aban 1298 – 5 Mordad 1359) was the second and last Shah of Iran of the Pahlavi dynasty, who ruled from 25 Shahrivar 1320 until 22 Bahman 1357.

quote: Mohammad Reza devient Chāhanchāh d'Iran le 16 septembre 1941. À 15h30, il quitte le Parlement et est acclamé par la foule, qui sent que quelque chose de terrible vient d'être évité.
section: Abdication de Reza Chah et accession au trône (1941)
translation: Mohammad Reza became Shah of Iran on 16 September 1941. At 3:30 p.m. he left Parliament and was cheered by the crowd, which felt that something terrible had just been avoided.

quote: Вскоре после того, как самолёт покинул Тегеран, в столице началось ликование. Газета «Кейхан» вышла со знаменитым заголовком «Шах бежал».
section: Последние месяцы у власти. Отъезд из Ирана
translation: Shortly after the plane left Tehran, jubilation began in the capital. The newspaper 'Kayhan' came out with the famous headline 'The Shah Fled'.

quote: Tandis que l’avion vole à destination de l’Égypte, où les souverains iraniens sont attendus par le couple Sadate, le quotidien national Ettela'at titre en première page « Chah raft » (le roi s'en va).
translation: While the plane flew toward Egypt, where the Iranian sovereigns were awaited by the Sadat couple, the national daily Ettela'at ran the front-page headline 'Shah raft' (the king leaves).

quote: "The Shah Is Gone", iconic headline of the Iranian newspaper Ettela'at when the Shah left Iran

في نهاية عام 1973 وبينما كان الشاه في جزيرة كيش٬ لاحظ وجود تجويف في أدنى الجزء الايسر من القفص الصدري واعتقد أنه تضخم في الطحال٬ ولدى فحصه بعد ذلك تبين وجود تضخم في الطحال، ولكن ليس هناك تضخم في الغدد. وكان الشاه آنذاك في الرابعة والخمسين من عمره. ولكن فيما بعد تبين أن الشاه مصاب بسرطان الغدد اللمفاوية.
translation: At the end of 1973, while the Shah was on Kish Island, he noticed a cavity in the lower left part of his ribcage and thought it was an enlarged spleen; upon examination afterward, an enlarged spleen was found, but no enlarged glands... However, it was later found that the Shah had lymphatic cancer.

quote: On 1 May 1974, French professor Dr. Georges Flandrin flew to Tehran to treat the Shah.  On the first visit, Flandrin was able to diagnose the Shah with chronic lymphocytic leukemia. The Shah's diagnosis of cancer would not be revealed to him until 1978.

Otra causa del aumento de las tensiones políticas entre la gente y el régimen monárquico fue el beneficio obtenido del petróleo que, pese a incrementarse por el alza internacional del precio del combustible fósil en la década de 1970, no se utilizó para cumplir las promesas del sah en cuanto a las mejoras sociales. Durante este periodo de tiempo, Persia poseyó los peores indicadores entre los países de Oriente Medio en relación con la educación y la mortalidad infantil.
section: Consolidación del régimen y Revolución Blanca
translation: Another cause of the increase in political tensions between the people and the monarchical regime was the profit obtained from oil which, despite increasing due to the international rise in the price of fossil fuel in the 1970s, was not used to fulfill the Shah's promises regarding social improvements. During this period of time, Persia possessed the worst indicators among Middle Eastern countries in relation to education and infant mortality.

quote: بدأ الشاه استثمارات كبيرة في البنية التحتية، ومنح إعانات ومنح أراضي للسكان الفلاحين، ومشاركة العمال الصناعيين في الأرباح، وبناء المنشآت النووية، وتأميم الموارد الطبيعية الإيرانية، وبرامج محو الأمية التي اعتبرت من بين الأكثر فاعلية في العالم.
translation: The Shah initiated major investments in infrastructure, subsidies and land grants for the peasant population, profit-sharing for industrial workers, construction of nuclear facilities, nationalization of Iranian natural resources, and literacy programs that were considered among the most effective in the world.

quote: ایران در طول حکومت ۳۷ ساله محمدرضا پهلوی میلیاردها دلار صرف هزینه‌های صنعتی، آموزشی، بهداشتی و نظامی کرد و از نرخ رشد اقتصادی فراتر از ایالات متحده، بریتانیا و فرانسه برخوردار بود.
translation: During the 37-year rule of Mohammad Reza Pahlavi, Iran spent billions of dollars on industrial, educational, health, and military expenses, and enjoyed an economic growth rate exceeding that of the United States, Britain, and France.

quote: Elementary school education was made free and mandatory; in 1974, $16 billion was spent on building new schools and hospitals.
בשנת 1973 היו לאיראן חובות על סך 3 מיליארד דולר. אך עם עליית מחירי הנפט, כנראה בעקבות יסוד אופ"ק ב-1960, שנה לאחר מכן החזירה איראן את כל חובותיה והחלה להרוויח 19 מיליארד דולר לשנה מהנפט.
translation: In 1973 Iran had debts of 3 billion dollars. But with the rise in oil prices, probably following the founding of OPEC in 1960, a year later Iran paid off all its debts and began earning 19 billion dollars a year from oil.

quote: By the mid-1970s, Iran's national debt was paid off, turning the nation from a debtor to a creditor nation. The balances on the nation's account for the 1959–78 period resulted in a surplus of approximately $15.17 billion.

وادعت المعارضة ان الحكومة صرفت على ذلك الاحتفال مبالغ ضخمة قدرت بمئات الملايين من الدولارات بهدف تشويه صورة الحكومة. والحقيقة أن كلفة الاحتفالات كانت مائة وخمسين مليون تومان أو ما يعادل خمسة وعشرين مليون دولار أمريكي حسب الوثائق الرسمية الإيرانية.
section: احتفاله بمرور 2500 عام لإنشاء مملكة فارس
translation: The opposition claimed that the government spent huge sums on that celebration estimated at hundreds of millions of dollars in order to tarnish the government's image. In reality, the cost of the celebrations was 150 million tomans, or the equivalent of 25 million US dollars, according to official Iranian documents.

quote: En 1967, se coronó como Shahanshah en una fastuosa ceremonia de coronación, a la que asistieron personalidades de todo el mundo.
section: Consolidación del régimen y Revolución Blanca
translation: In 1967, he was crowned as Shahanshah in a lavish coronation ceremony, which was attended by personalities from all over the world.

quote: Die Krönung war als eine iranische Feierlichkeit organisiert worden, zu der keine ausländischen Staatsgäste geladen waren. Einzig Karim Aga Khan IV. wohnte als Gast der Krönungszeremonie bei.
translation: The coronation had been organized as an Iranian celebration to which no foreign state guests were invited. Only Karim Aga Khan IV attended the coronation ceremony as a guest.

quote: 1967'de Şehinşah (Kralların Kralı) ünvanını aldı ve 1971'de Pers İmparatorluğu'nun 2500. yıldönümünü kutlamak üzere bir tören düzenledi.
translation: In 1967 he took the title of Shahanshah (King of Kings) and in 1971 organized a ceremony to celebrate the 2500th anniversary of the Persian Empire.

quote: En 1967, tomó el título de Sahansah (literalmente 'rey de reyes'),​ y también ocupó varios otros, incluyendo Aryamehr (lit. 'Luz de los arios') y Bozorg Arteshtaran (lit. 'Gran Comandante del Ejército').
translation: In 1967, he took the title of Shahanshah (literally 'King of Kings'), and also held several others, including Aryamehr (lit. 'Light of the Aryans') and Bozorg Arteshtaran (lit. 'Grand Commander of the Army').

quote: 26 октября 1967 года Мохаммед Реза Пехлеви получил титул Шаханшах («Царь царей»).
translation: On 26 October 1967 Mohammad Reza Pahlavi received the title Shahanshah ('King of Kings').

quote: Am 26. Oktober 1967 krönte er sich zum Schahanschah („König der Könige“).
translation: On 26 October 1967 he crowned himself Shahanshah ('King of Kings').

quote: Mit der Errichtung des Senats konnte Pahlavi seine Machtbasis gegenüber dem Parlament erweitern, da die Senatoren je zur Hälfte von ihm ernannt und von der Bevölkerung direkt gewählt wurden.
translation: With the establishment of the Senate, Pahlavi was able to expand his power base vis-à-vis parliament, as half of the senators were appointed by him and half were directly elected by the population.

quote: Avec la création du Sénat, Mohammad Reza Shah fut en mesure d'élargir son pouvoir parlementaire, puisque les sénateurs sont nommés par le Shah et non directement élus par la population.
section: Le jeune shah et son royaume à la fin des années 1940
translation: With the creation of the Senate, Mohammad Reza Shah was able to expand his parliamentary power, since senators are appointed by the Shah and not directly elected by the population.

quote: Arrivé par la porte principale du bâtiment, Mohammad Reza Pahlavi reçoit deux balles d'un pistolet de petit calibre, un 6,35 mm. La première balle atteint la joue droite, passant entre la gencive et la lèvre, et sort sous le nez. La seconde effleure le dos, arrachant des chairs de l'omoplate.
translation: Arriving through the main door of the building, Mohammad Reza Pahlavi received two bullets from a small-caliber pistol, a 6.35 mm. The first bullet hit the right cheek, passing between the gum and the lip, and exited under the nose. The second grazed the back, tearing flesh from the shoulder blade.

quote: Büyük devletlerin baskısı sonucu babası Rıza Pehlevi'nin tahttan çekilmesi üzerine tahta çıktı (16 Eylül 1941).
translation: Following the abdication of his father Reza Pahlavi as a result of pressure from the great powers, he ascended the throne (16 September 1941).

quote: Mohammad Reza Pahlavi wurde am 17. September 1941 um 16:30 Uhr durch die Ablegung des Amtseides vor dem iranischen Parlament Schah des Irans.
translation: Mohammad Reza Pahlavi became Shah of Iran on 17 September 1941 at 4:30 p.m. by taking the oath of office before the Iranian parliament.

quote: On 16 September 1941, Prime Minister Mohammad Ali Foroughi and Foreign Minister Ali Soheili attended a special session of parliament to announce the resignation of Reza Shah and that Mohammad Reza was to replace him. The next day, at 4:30 p.m., Mohammad Reza took the oath of office and was received warmly by parliamentarians.

Vor dem Hintergrund der Verbesserung der diplomatischen Beziehungen heiratete Kronprinz Mohammad Reza am 15. März 1939 Prinzessin Fausia von Ägypten im Abdeen-Palast von Kairo. Die Braut war eine Tochter des ägyptischen Königs Fu'ād I. Nach ihrer Ankunft in Iran wurde die Hochzeitszeremonie in Teheran nach schiitischem Ritus wiederholt.
translation: Against the backdrop of improving diplomatic relations, Crown Prince Mohammad Reza married Princess Fawzia of Egypt on 15 March 1939 in the Abdeen Palace in Cairo. The bride was a daughter of the Egyptian King Fuad I. After her arrival in Iran, the wedding ceremony was repeated in Tehran according to the Shiite rite.

quote: Moins d'un an plus tard, le 16 mars 1939, Mohammad Reza Pahlavi épouse la princesse Faouzia au palais d'Abedin, au Caire, selon le rite chiite. Une seconde cérémonie, de rite sunnite, se déroule à Téhéran, au palais impérial du Golestan, le 25 avril 1939.
translation: Less than a year later, on 16 March 1939, Mohammad Reza Pahlavi married Princess Fawzia at Abdeen Palace in Cairo, according to the Shiite rite. A second ceremony, of the Sunni rite, took place in Tehran, at the Golestan Imperial Palace, on 25 April 1939.

quote: Le 16 mars 1939, Mohammad Reza épouse Faouzia au palais d'Abedin, au Caire, selon le rite sunnite. Il ne garde pas un très bon souvenir de l'étalage de luxe qui accompagne son mariage égyptien, qu'il ressent comme une humiliation envers son pays plus simple et modeste. Une seconde cérémonie, de rite chiite, se déroule à Téhéran, au palais impérial du Golestan, le 25 avril 1939.
translation: On 16 March 1939, Mohammad Reza married Fawzia at Abdeen Palace in Cairo, according to the Sunni rite. He did not keep a very good memory of the display of luxury accompanying his Egyptian marriage... A second ceremony, of the Shiite rite, took place in Tehran, at the Golestan Imperial Palace, on 25 April 1939.

quote: Seinen siebenjährigen Sohn Mohammad Reza ernannte er per Dekret vom 27. Januar 1926 zum Kronprinzen und zum Oberst der persischen Armee.
translation: He appointed his seven-year-old son Mohammad Reza Crown Prince and colonel of the Persian army by decree of 27 January 1926.

quote: En 1925, bénéficiant d'une éducation stricte à la fois militaire et occidentale, Mohammad Reza Pahlavi gagne le prytanée Nezam, deux jours après qu'une loi lui confère le titre de prince héritier, qu'il devient officiellement le 26 janvier 1926.
translation: In 1925, benefiting from a strict education both military and Western, Mohammad Reza Pahlavi entered the Nezam military school, two days after a law conferred upon him the title of Crown Prince, which he officially became on 26 January 1926.

quote: او در دوران حکومت پدرش از ۴ اردیبهشت ۱۳۰۵ تا ۲۵ شهریور ۱۳۲۰ ولیعهد ایران بود.
translation: During his father's reign, from 4 Ordibehesht 1305 [24 April 1926] to 25 Shahrivar 1320 [16 September 1941], he was the Crown Prince of Iran.

quote: On 24 April 1926, the day before his father's coronation, six-year-old Mohammad Reza was proclaimed Crown Prince of the newly established Pahlavi dynasty.
Über 400 Tote waren bei dem Brandanschlag auf das Cinema Rex in Abadan zu verzeichnen.
translation: Over 400 deaths were recorded in the arson attack on the Cinema Rex in Abadan.

quote: Le 19 août, lors du 25e anniversaire de la chute du gouvernement de Mossadegh, plus de 400 personnes moururent dans l'incendie criminel du cinéma Rex à Abadan.
translation: On 19 August, on the 25th anniversary of the fall of the Mossadegh government, more than 400 people died in the arson of the Rex cinema in Abadan.

quote: Nach seiner Flucht über Ägypten, Marokko, die Bahamas und Mexiko kam der krebskranke Pahlavi am 22. Oktober 1979 in New York an
section: == Stationen der Flucht, Krankheit und Tod ==
translation: After fleeing via Egypt, Morocco, the Bahamas and Mexico, the cancer-stricken Pahlavi arrived in New York on 22 October 1979.

quote: First, he flew from Tehran to Aswan, Egypt, where he received a warm and gracious welcome from President Anwar El-Sadat. He later lived in Marrakesh, Morocco, as a guest of King Hassan II.
El sah y su esposa se exiliaron en diversos países: Marruecos, Bahamas, Ecuador, México,​ los Estados Unidos, Panamá y finalmente Egipto, donde fueron acogidos por el presidente Anwar el-Sadat.
translation: The Shah and his wife went into exile in various countries: Morocco, the Bahamas, Ecuador, Mexico, the United States, Panama and finally Egypt, where they were welcomed by President Anwar el-Sadat.

quote: After returning to Iran, Mohammad Reza completed his secondary education and enrolled at the Madrasa Nezam, a military academy in Tehran.
Le jeune prince revient ensuite en Suisse pour y terminer ses études : en juin 1937, il réussit ses épreuves de maturité gymnasiale.
translation: The young prince then returned to Switzerland to finish his studies: in June 1937, he passed his gymnasial maturité exams.

quote: اما سوابق موجود در مدرسه نشان می‌دهد که محمدرضا پیش از دریافت دیپلم، به درخواست پدرش و به دلایل سیاسی به ایران بازگشته است و تحصیلاتش را در ایران ادامه داده است.
translation: But existing school records show that Mohammad Reza, before receiving a diploma, returned to Iran at his father's request and for political reasons, and continued his studies in Iran.

quote: Dans le cadre de la guerre froide, on a souvent dit que les États-Unis avaient restauré le pouvoir absolu au chah dans le cadre de l’opération Ajax, ce qui est faux.
section: ==== Retour au pouvoir et chute de Mossadegh : un tournant ====
translation: In the context of the Cold War, it has often been said that the United States restored absolute power to the Shah as part of Operation Ajax, which is false.

quote: Sur les six balles contenues dans le pistolet, trois se logent dans le képi du souverain et une reste bloquée dans le barillet.
translation: Of the six bullets in the pistol, three lodged in the sovereign's kepi and one remained stuck in the barrel. (The same section says the Shah was hit by two bullets: one through the cheek and one grazing the shoulder blade.)

quote: 6 января 1979 года на Гваделупе состоялись переговоры США, Великобритании, Франции и ФРГ, на которых обсуждалась обстановка в Иране.
section: === Последние месяцы у власти. Отъезд из Ирана ===
translation: On 6 January 1979, talks between the USA, Great Britain, France and the FRG took place in Guadeloupe, at which the situation in Iran was discussed.

quote: Vom 4. Januar bis 7. Januar 1979 fand auf Einladung des französischen Präsidenten Valéry Giscard d’Estaing in Guadeloupe die Konferenz von Guadeloupe statt.
translation: From 4 January to 7 January 1979, at the invitation of French President Valéry Giscard d'Estaing, the Guadeloupe conference took place.

quote: Du 4 au 7 janvier 1979, à l'invitation du président français Valéry Giscard d'Estaing, une conférence eut lieu en Guadeloupe.
section: ==== La conférence de la Guadeloupe et le lâchage occidental ====
translation: From 4 to 7 January 1979, at the invitation of French President Valéry Giscard d'Estaing, a conference took place in Guadeloupe.

quote: On 7 December 1978, it was announced that President Carter of the US, President Valéry Giscard d'Estaing of France, Chancellor Helmut Schmidt of West Germany and Prime Minister James Callaghan of the United Kingdom would meet in Guadeloupe on 5 January 1979 to discuss the crisis in Iran.
Durumunun ümitsizliğini gören Muhammed Rızâ Pehlevî, 16 Ocak 1979'da kesin olarak ülkeyi terk etti
translation: Seeing the hopelessness of his situation, Mohammad Reza Pahlavi left the country for good on 16 January 1979.

quote: او در ۱۷ ژانویهٔ ۱۹۷۹ ایران را ترک کرد
translation: He left Iran on 17 January 1979. (Note: the Persian lead instead says 26 Dey 1357, i.e. 16 January 1979.)

quote: On 16 January 1979, the Shah left Iran for exile, transferring his duties to a regency council.
خمینی سال بعد به ترکیه و سپس به عراق تبعید شد.
translation: Khomeini was exiled the following year [after 1963] to Turkey and then to Iraq.

translation: The official divorce was therefore granted on 17 November 1948, on condition that Princess Shahnaz remain under her father's responsibility.

translation: The marriage was divorced on 19 November 1948.

translation: The divorce between them took place in 1945 in Cairo, and afterwards the divorce took place in Iran in 1948.

translation: Pahlavi's first marriage, to the Egyptian Princess Fawzia, was concluded on 16 March 1939. (Note: an earlier German section, 'Seine Ehen', says 15 March 1939.)

translation: On 16 March 1939, Mohammad Reza married Faouzia at Abdeen Palace in Cairo, according to the Sunni rite.

translation: He died on 27 July 1980 of the consequences of Waldenström's macroglobulinemia (a non-Hodgkin lymphoma). During his reign he had refused chemotherapy for an illness that had already been diagnosed in 1972.

translation: The revolt is crushed: 68 dead are counted, 400 arrests out of about 5,000 participants, Qom having more than 500,000 inhabitants.

translation: The real number of people killed for political offences during Mohammad Reza Shah's 37-year reign was about 1,500.

translation: He concluded that between 1963 and 1979 a total of 3,164 Iranians were killed in the struggle against the regime, of whom 2,781 died in the revolutionary unrest of 1977/78.

translation: Estimates of the total number of deaths during the Islamic Revolution range between 540 and 2,000 (figures from independent studies) and 60,000 (figures from the Islamic government).

translation: Estimates of the total number of deaths during the Islamic Revolution range between 540 and 2,000 (according to independent studies) and 60,000 (according to Islamic government figures).

translation: The Jaleh Square incident (17 Shahrivar 1357), in which the army wounded dozens of protesters

translation: Fakhr-Arai fired, but the Shah was only lightly wounded in the cheek.

translation: Mohammad Reza Pahlavi received two bullets from a small-calibre pistol, a 6.35 mm. The first bullet struck the right cheek, passing between the gum and the lip and exiting under the nose. The second grazed his back, tearing flesh from his shoulder blade.

quote: gunman Fakhr-Arai fired five shots at him at a range of about three metres. Only one of the shots hit the king, grazing his cheek.

section: Retour au pouvoir et chute de Mossadegh : un tournant
translation: A few years after the operation, in 1957, the Shah created the implacable and cruel SAVAK with the help of the CIA and Mossad.

translation: The organization, which was trained both by the CIA and by the Israeli Mossad, worked vigorously to suppress political opposition.

quote: اما ژیسکار دستن در مصاحبه با روزنامه توس در سال ۱۳۷۷ گفته بود که «تنها کشوری که در این جلسه زنگ خاتمهٔ حکومت شاه را به صدا درآورد نمایندهٔ آمریکا بود و معتقد بود وقت تغییر حکومت ایران است به‌طوری که همهٔ ما متحیر و متعجب شدیم.
translation: But Giscard d'Estaing, in an interview with the Tous newspaper in 1377 (1998), said that 'the only country that rang the death knell of the Shah's government at this meeting was the American representative, who believed it was time for a change of Iran's government — so much so that we were all stunned and astonished.'

quote: For Mohammad Reza, this announcement was the final blow, and he was convinced that the Western leaders were holding the meeting to discuss how best to abandon him.
في «مؤتمر غوادلوب» عام 1979، أعلن حلفاؤه الغربيون عدم وجود طريقة ممكنة لإنقاذ الملكية الإيرانية من الإطاحة.
translation: At the 1979 'Guadeloupe conference', his Western allies declared that there was no viable way to save the Iranian monarchy from being overthrown.

quote: Le président Jimmy Carter a déclaré que, de façon surprenante, les États-Unis avaient décidé de ne plus soutenir le régime du Shah. Sans le soutien des États-Unis, le régime était perdu.
section: La conférence de la Guadeloupe et le lâchage occidental
translation: President Jimmy Carter stated that, surprisingly, the United States had decided to no longer support the Shah's regime. Without American support, the regime was lost.

quote: أصبح موقف الشاه غير مستدام بعد حريق سينما ريكس ومجزرة ميدان جاله.
translation: The Shah's position became unsustainable after the Cinema Rex fire and the Jaleh Square massacre.

quote: آتش‌سوزی سینما رکس، اعتراضاتی را در سراسر ایران به دنبال داشت.
translation: The Cinema Rex fire was followed by protests across Iran.

quote: Khomeini quitte l'Iran pour l'Irak, s'installant à Nadjaf.
section: De nouvelles tensions et la reprise économique
translation: Khomeini left Iran for Iraq, settling in Najaf.

quote: روح‌الله خمینی دستگیر شد و مدتی را در زندان گذراند. خمینی سال بعد به ترکیه و سپس به عراق تبعید شد.
translation: Ruhollah Khomeini was arrested and spent some time in prison. The following year Khomeini was exiled to Turkey and then to Iraq.

quote: At least 200 people were killed, with the police throwing some students to their deaths from high buildings, and Khomeini was exiled to Iraq in 4 October 1965.
1967'de Şehinşah (Kralların Kralı) ünvanını aldı
translation: In 1967 he took the title Shahinshah (King of Kings).

translation: On 26 October 1967 he considered the day to have come. The coronation was organized as an Iranian ceremony to which no foreign guests of state were invited.

quote: On 26 October 1967, 26 years into his reign as Shah ("King"), he took the ancient title Shāhanshāh ("Emperor" or "King of Kings") in a lavish coronation ceremony held in Tehran.
عام 1979، اتخذ لقب «شاهنشاه» (ملك الملوك)، وحمل ألقابًا أخرى عديدة منها «آريامهر» (نور الآريين) و«بزرگ ارتشتاران» (القائد الأعلى للجيش).
translation: In 1979 he took the title 'Shahanshah' (King of Kings), and also held many other titles including 'Aryamehr' (Light of the Aryans) and 'Bozorg Arteshtaran' (Supreme Commander of the Army).

quote: في 1967 قام الشاه محمد رضا بهلوي بتتويج زوجته الثالثة فرح ديبا في احتفال كبير ومنحها لقب (الشاهبانو)
translation: In 1967 Shah Mohammad Reza Pahlavi crowned his third wife Farah Diba in a grand ceremony and granted her the title of Shahbanu.

translation: The real number of people killed for political crimes during Mohammad Reza Shah's 37-year reign was around 1,500. This figure is lower than the figures proposed by the opposition.

translation: Estimates of the total number of deaths during the Islamic Revolution range from 540 to 2,000 (figures from independent studies) to 60,000 (figures from the Islamic government).

translation: Estimates of the total number of deaths during the Islamic Revolution range from 540 to 2,000 (per independent studies) to 60,000 (per Islamic government figures).

quote: Las calles se llenaron de multitudes que protestaban por la decisión del sah y, en vista de este grave panorama, tomó un avión para huir de Persia junto con su esposa, Soraya Esfandiary.
translation: The streets filled with crowds protesting the Shah's decision, and in view of this serious situation, he took a plane to flee Persia with his wife, Soraya Esfandiary.

quote: Ocak 1978'de, on beş yıl önce İran'dan sürülen Şii topluluğun ruhani önderi Ruhullah Humeyni'ye karşı hakaret dolu bir makalenin yayımlanması, Kum kentinde bir protesto yürüyüşüne yol açtı. SAVAK kalabalığa ateş açarak yaklaşık yüz kişinin ölümüne neden oldu (9 Ocak).
translation: In January 1978, the publication of an insulting article against Ruhollah Khomeini, the spiritual leader of the Shia community expelled from Iran fifteen years earlier, led to a protest march in Qom. SAVAK opened fire on the crowd, causing the deaths of about one hundred people (9 January).

quote: Selon le gouvernement, 86 personnes avaient péri dans les affrontements avec les forces de sécurité dans tout Téhéran qui avaient fait 205 blessés, et 64 personnes avaient été tuées sur la place Jaleh.
translation: According to the government, 86 people had died in the clashes with the security forces across Tehran, with 205 wounded, and 64 people had been killed on Jaleh Square.

quote: Tehrani gab die Zahl der an diesem Tag bei Zusammenstößen mit den Sicherheitskräften in ganz Teheran Umgekommenen und Verletzten mit 86 Toten und 205 Verwundeten an, wovon 64 Personen am Dschaleh-Platz zu Tode gekommen seien.
translation: Tehrani gave the number of those killed and injured that day in clashes with security forces across Tehran as 86 dead and 205 wounded, of whom 64 people were killed on Jaleh Square.

quote: That day, at least 64 and perhaps 100 or more people were shot dead, and the Pahlavi military injured 205 in Jaleh Square.
Suit une agonie de plusieurs semaines qui prend fin le dimanche 27 juillet vers 5 h du matin.
section: Seconde étape égyptienne (24 mars au 27 juillet 1980)
translation: An agony of several weeks followed, ending on Sunday 27 July at around 5 a.m.

quote: سرانجام در ساعت ۹:۴۵ دقیقه روز ۵ مرداد ۱۳۵۹ خورشیدی، محمدرضا پهلوی در ۶۰ سالگی در قاهره درگذشت.
translation: Finally, at 9:45 a.m. on 5 Mordad 1359 (Solar Hijri), Mohammad Reza Pahlavi died in Cairo at the age of 60.

quote: Shortly after, the Shah slipped into a coma and died at 9:15 a.m. on 27 July 1980 at age 60.
החל משנת 1974, סבל השאה מסרטן הדם מסוג CLL. המחלה, וכן התרופות שקיבל כנגדה, בעיקר פרדניזון, פגעו בתפקודו הפיזי והנפשי
translation: From 1974 the Shah suffered from CLL-type blood cancer. The illness, and the drugs he received for it, mainly prednisone, harmed his physical and mental functioning.

quote: في نهاية عام 1973 وبينما كان الشاه في جزيرة كيش٬ لاحظ وجود تجويف في أدنى الجزء الايسر من القفص الصدري واعتقد أنه تضخم في الطحال
translation: At the end of 1973, while the Shah was on Kish Island, he noticed a hollow in the lower left part of his rib cage and believed it was an enlarged spleen.

quote: Zu seinen Regierungszeiten hatte er eine chemotherapeutische Behandlung seiner Erkrankung, die bereits 1972 diagnostiziert worden war, abgelehnt.
section: Stationen der Flucht, Krankheit und Tod
translation: During his time in government he had refused chemotherapy treatment for his illness, which had already been diagnosed in 1972.

quote: On 1 May 1974, French professor Dr. Georges Flandrin flew to Tehran to treat the Shah.
ولكن فيما بعد تبين أن الشاه مصاب بسرطان الغدد اللمفاوية. التي أدت إلى وفاته لاحقًا.
translation: But it later became clear that the Shah suffered from lymphatic-gland cancer, which led to his death.

quote: החל משנת 1974, סבל השאה מסרטן הדם מסוג CLL
translation: From 1974 onwards, the Shah suffered from CLL-type blood cancer.

quote: El sah murió el 27 de julio de 1980 en El Cairo, debido a complicaciones surgidas tras una operación de bazo, derivada del linfoma no Hodgkin (cáncer linfático) que padecía desde hacía años.
translation: The Shah died on 27 July 1980 in Cairo from complications following a spleen operation necessitated by the non-Hodgkin lymphoma, or lymphatic cancer, from which he had suffered for years.

quote: Atteint de la maladie de Waldenström, Mohammad Reza Pahlavi doit subir une intervention chirurgicale dans les plus brefs délais : la chimiothérapie, à base de Chlorambucil, prescrite par les hématologues français, a atteint ses limites et il devient impératif de procéder à une splénectomie.
translation: Suffering from Waldenström's disease, Mohammad Reza Pahlavi must undergo surgery as soon as possible: the chlorambucil-based chemotherapy prescribed by the French hematologists has reached its limits, and a splenectomy has become imperative.

quote: ولكن فيما بعد تبين أن الشاه مصاب بسرطان الغدد اللمفاوية.
translation: But later it became clear that the Shah had cancer of the lymph glands.

quote: Nach heutigem Wissen war für die Planung und Durchführung des Brandanschlags ein Verwandter von Seyyed Ali Chamenei verantwortlich gewesen.
translation: According to present knowledge, a relative of Seyyed Ali Khamenei had been responsible for planning and carrying out the arson attack.

quote: Khomeini, comme Mehdī Bāzargān et Karim Sandjabi, les principaux cadres du Front national, accusèrent le gouvernement d'être responsable de l’incendie et de vouloir discréditer l'opposition. De ce qu’on sait aujourd’hui, un parent de Seyyed Ali Khamenei fut responsable de la planification et de l'exécution de l’incendie pour précipiter la révolution.
translation: Khomeini, like Mehdī Bāzargān and Karim Sandjabi, leading National Front figures, accused the government of responsibility for the fire and of wanting to discredit the opposition. From what is known today, a relative of Seyyed Ali Khamenei was responsible for planning and carrying out the fire to precipitate the revolution.

quote: Er erklärte, dass auf die Truppen am Dschaleh-Platz geschossen worden sei und dass diese dann zurückgeschossen hätten. In den Zug der Demonstranten hatten sich in Libyen und Palästina ausgebildete und bewaffnete Agitatoren eingereiht, die die Stimmung anheizen sollten.
translation: He stated that the troops in Jaleh Square had been fired upon and had then returned fire. Armed agitators trained in Libya and Palestine had joined the demonstration procession and were supposed to inflame the atmosphere.

quote: Tehrani expliqua qu’on avait tiré sur les troupes de la place Jaleh et qu’elles auraient alors riposté. On trouvait dans la foule manifestante des agitateurs formés et armés en Libye et en Palestine.
translation: Tehrani explained that the troops in Jaleh Square had been fired upon and had reportedly then returned fire. Among the demonstrating crowd were agitators trained and armed in Libya and Palestine.

quote: در این روز که بعدها به نام جمعهٔ سیاه معروف شد، هزاران نفر در میدان ژاله تهران برای یک تظاهرات مذهبی گرد آمدند. وقتی مردم حکومت نظامی را نادیده گرفتند، سربازان به سویشان آتش گشودند که در نتیجه آن برخی از مردم کشته یا مجروح شدند.
translation: On this day, which later became known as Black Friday, thousands of people gathered in Tehran's Jaleh Square for a religious demonstration. When the people ignored martial law, soldiers opened fire on them, as a result of which some people were killed or wounded.

quote: The Shah-centred command structure of the Iranian military and the lack of training to confront civil unrest were marked by disaster and bloodshed. There were several instances where army units had opened fire, the most significant being the events on 8 September 1978.
SAVAK kalabalığa ateş açarak yaklaşık yüz kişinin ölümüne neden oldu (9 Ocak).
translation: SAVAK opened fire on the crowd, causing the deaths of approximately one hundred people (9 January).

quote: Die am 9. Januar von Studenten in Qom organisierte Sympathiekundgebung für Chomeini wurde von den Sicherheitskräften gewaltsam aufgelöst. Vier Demonstranten kamen dabei zu Tode.
translation: The demonstration of support for Khomeini organized by students in Qom on 9 January was forcibly dispersed by the security forces. Four demonstrators died.

quote: Le 9 janvier, à Qom, une manifestation organisée par des étudiants en soutien à Khomeini contre l'article calomnieux fut violemment réprimée par les forces de sécurité. Quatre manifestants y perdent la vie.
translation: On 9 January in Qom, a demonstration organized by students in support of Khomeini against the defamatory article was violently suppressed by security forces. Four demonstrators lost their lives there.

quote: والحقيقة أن كلفة الاحتفالات كانت مائة وخمسين مليون تومان أو ما يعادل خمسة وعشرين مليون دولار أمريكي حسب الوثائق الرسمية الإيرانية.

translation: In fact, the cost of the celebrations was one hundred and fifty million tomans, equivalent to twenty-five million US dollars, according to official Iranian documents.

quote: Шах пытался порвать со многими исламскими традициями, даже ввёл летосчисление не от хиджры, а от начала династии Ахеменидов (1976 год от Рождества Христова, ранее считавшийся 1355 годом хиджры, был объявлен 2535 годом шахиншахской власти), но вскоре был вынужден отменить это непопулярное нововведение.
translation: The Shah tried to break with many Islamic traditions, even introducing a calendar reckoned not from the Hijra but from the beginning of the Achaemenid dynasty (AD 1976, previously counted as the year 1355 of the Hijra, was declared the year 2535 of Shahanshah rule), but was soon forced to abolish this unpopular innovation.

quote: 1976 erfolgte die Einführung eines neuen Kalenders, der als Anfangspunkt der Zeitrechnung nicht die Hidschra Mohammeds, sondern die Krönung des Königs Kyros des Großen hatte, für die Geistlichkeit ein Affront.
translation: In 1976 a new calendar was introduced whose starting point was not Muhammad's Hijra but the coronation of King Cyrus the Great, an affront to the clergy.

quote: Le gouvernement s'attire encore les foudres des religieux en remplaçant en 1976 le calendrier solaire islamique par un calendrier solaire impérial, commençant non plus au jour où Mahomet quitta La Mecque pour Médine, mais au jour où Babylone fut prise par Cyrus : l'année passa de 1355 à 2535, ce qui ne fut pas une mesure populaire, qui surtout déconcerta les Iraniens avec ce nouveau calendrier.
translation: The government again provokes the religious authorities' anger by replacing the Islamic solar calendar in 1976 with an imperial solar calendar, beginning no longer on the day Muhammad left Mecca for Medina but on the day Babylon was captured by Cyrus: the year changed from 1355 to 2535, an unpopular measure that above all bewildered Iranians with this new calendar.

quote: در سال ۱۳۵۴، شاه آغاز تاریخ را به ۵۵۹ پیش از میلاد تغییر داد و گاه‌شماری شاهنشاهی را، تاریخ رسمی کشور اعلام کرد.
translation: In 1354 Solar Hijri [1975–76], the Shah changed the starting point of the calendar to 559 BC and declared the imperial calendar the country's official calendar.

quote: Other actions thought to have contributed to his downfall include antagonising formerly apolitical Iranians—especially merchants of the bazaars—with the creation in 1975 of a single-party political monopoly (the Rastakhiz Party), with compulsory membership and dues, and general aggressive interference in the political, economic, and religious concerns of people's lives; and the 1976 change from an Islamic calendar to an Imperial calendar, marking the conquest of Babylon by Cyrus as the first day, instead of the migration of Muhammad from Mecca to Medina.

translation: They married in 1959, and Queen Farah became Shahbanou, or Empress, a title created specifically for her in 1967.

translation: Alongside his own coronation, Mohammad Reza Pahlavi wanted his wife Farah Pahlavi also to be crowned, for the first time in the 2,500-year history of the Iranian monarchy.

translation: On 26 October 1967 he considered the day to have arrived.

translation: The organization, trained by both the CIA and Israel's Mossad, worked vigorously to suppress political opposition, especially initially from the pro-communist left and later from independent Islamic movements.

translation: To gain control of Iran's nationalized oil reserves, the CIA financed a military coup to remove Prime Minister Mosaddegh from power.

translation: In 1925–1930 Mohammad Reza Pahlavi studied at the Persian cadet corps, then at the Institut Le Rosey boarding school in Switzerland, and in 1936–1938 at the officer school in Tehran.

translation: He was educated at the Swiss boarding school Le Rosey, then completed his education in Iran at military college in 1935.
